summary: One entry per version of each component of the set view, written by scripts/write-units.mjs from component.json x-history (kind, consumer note, evidence) and the version's migration entry (changes). Former public names are dated in each component's aliases.json.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host; openCustomize() now opens «Вид». The list look is fixed (owner decision C404, 2026-11-21): the search framed, «Создать» and the data menu «⋯» (more_horiz, C407) on, the presentation strip framed with «Колонки» (a table) and «Вид» at its end; a search that does not fit takes its own full-width row. The footer is the table's last band: the range at the start, the page numbers centred, «По N» at the end, «Показать ещё» under the last row. «Вид» is SIMAI Framework sf-settings in its drill look, each row applied at once, with each display kind's own rows (C405): the table density, one line, lines between columns, «Подгрузка» and row actions; the board's lane field, empty lanes and card fields; the cards' size, field labels, «Подгрузка» (new, DEV on round 13: D1 for the cards, layouts.cards.paging) and card fields; the calendar's date and colour fields. «Настроить вид» and its «Для всех моих списков» row are gone: the person's look holds for every list of the same kind (C408; the general preference sf-view/* for the cards' and the board's own rows, sf-table/* for the table's). The table's gear above «≡» is always drawn and opens the column window, under the list head too (C406). The marks stay across pages and display kinds (LV2-2, C295, C298): a bulk action takes every mark; «Выбраны все N» carried from the table marks every card (LV2-7).  The data menu «⋯» has a look of its own, the view's head.menu outline (the default, the height and frame of the search and «Создать»), tonal or ghost (LV3-9). Saved filter-set rows have «⋯» (LV3-23). One bulk bar: under sf-view the cards draw none (bulk-bar false) and the list's bar counts their marks; after a switch to the cards their page row stays (VR13-1). LV4-2: the head observes each of its parts once (a ResizeObserver loop ran ~57 times a second). LV4-3: bulkActions = [] takes the boxes, the bar and the marks away, and the actions the view wrote on its page row. LV4-7: a saved filter set's marks and «⋯» stand at the row's end, icons of the row's size, and the filter window stays open after an action from «⋯». LV4-14: «Фильтр», the chips and «Очистить» one gap apart (C105). RV4-12: a list without its head is auto too (a table where there is room, rows on a phone); it was a table, squeezed into a phone. LV4-21: the marks stay when the same rows are set again (a part switched, the host port or a setting changed); the table's own clear as it takes rows is not heard as the person's.
entries.summary: C404 fixed list look and footer grid, C405 «Вид» as the sf-settings drill menu with per-kind rows, C406 the gear always, C407 more_horiz data menu, C408 the look for every list of the kind, LV2-2 marks across pages and kinds, LV2-7 «Выбраны все N» to the cards, D1 paging for the cards LV3-9 head.menu, LV3-23 saved sets «⋯» one bulk bar: the list's bar stands for the cards (cards bulk-bar false), the cards keep the page row after a click switch (VR13-1) LV4-2 head observer once, LV4-3 bulkActions [] clears, LV4-7 saved-set row end and window kept, LV4-14 one chip gap RV4-12 auto layout whatever the head LV4-21 marks kept over a part switch

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host; a host may set paging. The table's rows come by «Подгрузка» (owner decision D1, 2026-11-21): new setting paging = pages | more | both | endless, default both, kept per view (layouts.table.paging, the person's choice in «Настроить вид»). both: a full-width «Показать ещё» right under the last row, the page numbers under it and «1–20 из 48» beside them; the button appends the next page and the range grows. more hides the page numbers; endless loads the next page when the end of the list comes into view (not recommended for tables). The whole list head (title row, search, filters, view switch) sticks at the top of the page or of the scrolling container the list stands in, and the table head sticks under it (VHF-15). Kanban, cards and calendar settings in «Настроить вид» apply at once, and their field list holds the view's own fields (VHF-13). Under the list head «Настроить вид» also sets the table's «Плотность» (Обычная / Компактная) and «Текст в одну строку» (VR12A-1); a setting saved there no longer re-reads the list, so the rows «Показать ещё» added stay. Every part of the list head and footer can be switched off by the host (DEV round 5 returns, VR5): chrome takes search, filter, look and page-size beside toolbar, pagination, select and settings (a chrome that names none of them keeps them all, as before; one that names any is the whole list); the view document's head.chrome lists the parts shown and head.look the rows of «Настроить вид»; view.chrome / view.setChrome() and view.look do the same by a call. «Фильтр» goes by itself when the host describes no field to filter by. A head row left empty is not drawn. Without «Настроить вид» (look off) the zone toggle goes when nothing else is in the zone. A host without the row-actions capability gets no «≡» column (VR5-10). The cards have the list's page row (LV2-6): page numbers, «Показать ещё» and the page size under the grid, with «1–24 из 48» in the footer; the grid's own more button is gone while the row is on. A display kind switch keeps the record first on screen on screen (LV2-8): the new kind opens on the page that holds it, in its own page size, so the page row and the records agree; that record is held over switches back and forth until the person turns a page or asks anything else.
entries.summary: View round 13 (round/view-r13): D1 index.js paging (VIEW_PAGING, get paging, applyPaging, _drawMore into slot more, _showMore, _watchEndless; the range grows from the run's first page; data-sf-view-paging-off hides the pagination for more and endless; first paint draws the button skeleton); component.json settings.paging and the manifest input; lang head-paging*. VHF-15 head.js lays --sf-view--head-offset and --sf-view--stuck-head on [part=layout]; [part=head] sticks for head=list. VHF-13 ownLayoutSettings / applyLayoutSettings; board, cards and calendar options merge the person's settings; the view panel lists the view's own fields. D3 cards skeleton draws stacked fields. VR12A-1 js/head.js: the table kind's panel adds density radios and a single_line checkbox (set through sf-view-table setTableView); lang head-density*, head-single-line. NO_REFRESH_AFTER takes settings.save. VR5 (DEV msg-b581533a): index.js CHROME_PARTS + search, filter, look, page-size; CHROME_WITHIN maps them to toolbar and pagination; renders(part) hides a part the chrome attribute does not name once it names any part, and a part head.chrome does not name; chrome setter and setChrome(); look getter/setter (head.look or view.look); the first-paint head row holds only the filter and search the chrome keeps; _drawFooter hides .sf-view-footer-size without page-size. js/head.js filterShown (renders filter and describe() fields), render hides .sf-view-head-search, [data-filter-group], .sf-view-head-filter-icon, sf-popover[data-pop=view], .sf-view-head-tune and an empty .sf-view-head-row; _renderFields empties the fields box when the filter is off; _viewPanel draws only the rows head.look names. js/head.css display: none for those parts when hidden. VR5-5 js/head.js zoneUseful: a described list and personal-column-settings count only while look is drawn. VR5-10 index.js: the projection writes data-sf-row-menu-off on the table when a known host offers no row-actions (_rowMenuOff); the first paint leaves the «≡» column out where the known host gives it nothing to open (_settingsColumnUnused: no row-actions, no personal-column-settings outside the list head, no row-reorder). LV2-6: layout cards get the list's page row (pagination by default, the footer range, a page size chosen there kept for the cards); the cards' grid no longer offers its own more button while the row is drawn. LV2-8: switchLayout opens the new kind on the page holding the record first on screen, held over switches back and forth until the next query change; the head's kind switch no longer resets the page to 1.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. The list head answers to the width the list has: a record card docked beside the list (data-sf-drawer-dock-host pads the view) leaves less, and below 600 px of it the head is the phone head, as the table already turns into list rows there (it stayed the desktop head over list rows). When the search, «Создать» and «⋯» wrap onto a line of their own under the filter fields, that line starts at the row's start (it stood at the row's end with the start of the line empty). The head row has two states only (round 3, VHF-3 refined): everything on one row while «Фильтр», its fields, the search at 20rem, «Создать» and «⋯» fit; else two rows, the search across the width on top with «Создать» and «⋯» at its end, «Фильтр» and the fields below (the search stood alone at the end of a second row). The list title keeps its heading size in a compact area (VHF-9, C44: it went 20 -> 16). Without bulk actions the rows, cards and calendar events draw no boxes (VHF-11): a box is there to mark records for an action; a host that names select in its own chrome keeps them. The phone skeleton without list-shape is said as it is drawn (VR11A-2): a title and each field on a line of its own (values of a phrase's length); a list of short values that share a line should give list-shape ("1 1 1" for a title and three short fields on two lines, 85 px at 390, where the hint-less skeleton holds 109). Bulk actions given after the first draw (bulkActions, or actions written on the page row later) bring the boxes to the rows already drawn.

VHF-11 index.js hasBulkActions and selects() (bulkActions, or actions on the page row; chrome written keeps select), read where the table, board, cards (js/cards.js) and calendar (js/calendar.js) are told selectable and by the first paint; the bulkActions setter tells them again. Numbered above ui-pro's copies in pro-f6c43828e5f2 (sf-view 1.30.1, sf-view-table 1.29.4, sf-view-properties 1.24.0, group build 15), the highest on any origin branch of simai/ui-view and simai/ui-pro; this round's own step was 1.30.1, 1.29.4 and 1.23.10 on round/view-r12 a26f636 before Pro took those numbers. entries.consumer: Optional for a host: list-shape on the view (or its sf-view-table) says how a record of the phone's compact list looks -- the lines of each part, the title first ("1 1 2 1"), or "resource" for a list of resources -- and the skeleton draws that shape, so the list does not move when the records come; without it the skeleton is as before. A page row that says its total (total on sf-pagination) sizes the skeleton to the records left. «Изменено» compares a system view that names no layout with the layout the page wrote (else the host's first), not with the kind the list showed when the head first looked. 1.29.2 is simai/ui-pro's number (sf-view accepting dataview-port 1.16.0, already in this set's 1.29.1).
entries.summary: View round 11 (round/view-r11): index.js firstPaintRows caps the skeleton's rows by the printed page row's total from its current page (_printedRecordsLeft); listShape reads list-shape (the view, else its table) and _firstPaintMarkup draws each part as its lines ([data-lines]) or the resource row ([data-resource], the title and supporting lines on --sf-ui-2/3--control-height, the list's quarter-step padding and hairline gap); first-paint.css carries those rules; pageLayoutKind keeps the layout the page wrote at connect; head.js storedKind is the kind a system view naming no layout stands for (viewKind), and _openSavedView no longer remembers the shown kind as that view's. component.json, smart.manifest.json and docs.md declare list-shape.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. A phone list (size 1/2) skeleton row is as tall as its answered row of short values (109px at 390, was 93); after a bulk action the screen reader keeps «Готово N из N» instead of «Выбор снят», and the bar's words are Russian from its first count; a column switched off in «Настроить вид» leaves the table at once; a system view switched to another layout shows «Изменено» like after a filter change.
entries.summary: View round 10 (round/view-r10): first-paint.css sizes the phone list skeleton line at text step 1 (R9-1); index.js draws the bulk bar together with the list and clears the selection before the bar's result (V10-1); head.js viewKind() keeps the kind the view opened with for the «Изменено» mark (V10-3) and _showColumns() applies «Настроить вид» columns to the table (V10-2); examples.json phone-list example in the first-paint gate.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. Over a pair that carries sf-bulk-actions (ui-b654460cad2a and later) the marked rows' band of a table is the group actions bar (Larena L-2, C295): «Выбрано N», the actions as buttons (up to three, the rest and a deleting one in «⋯»), «Выбрать все N» where the host offers bulk-under-filter, the cross and Escape; the host's answer is the bar's result line (done, or the refused rows with the reason, «Подробнее», «Повторить для N»). The actions, words and events stay the page row's (actions, selected-label, actions-region-label, bulkActions with icons) and the port's (bulk.apply_selected, bulk.apply_under_filter). Over an older pair the band of before stays. Before the first answer the page row's line of arrows is held only when the page writes its count (total over a page, has-next or a current page past the first) on sf-pagination; a one-page list no longer loses 48px at 390 when its answer comes.
entries.summary: View round 9 (round/view-r9, Larena L-2): index.js _renderBulkBand draws sf-bulk-actions (slot bulk, place dock, data-sf-bulk=bar) where bulkBarAvailable(), its actions from the page row's bulkActions (icons from the view's bulkActions), page-count from bulkPageCount, total and all-selected from the page row's for-all; sf-bulk-actions-action raises bulk.apply_selected or bulk.apply_under_filter and the answer goes to bar.result(); -select-all/-select-page set the page row's for-all; -clear clears the selection. rule.js and relations cl-bulk-actions (lazy), composition.uses smart.bulk-actions. The skeleton's footer prints the page row's arrows and field only where the page row the page wrote draws them (firstPaintHasPages: current past 1, has-next, or a total over one page), the rule of sf-pagination 1.10.0; printed for a one-page list they stood 48px under the range at 390 and went when the answer came (gate 24, view/reference and view/open-record @390).

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. The list head's view toggle draws its glyph open and closed: over a pair without the toggle look it is a disclosure button (aria-expanded) with the pressed look drawn by the head, and the glyph stays outlined; a pressed button asked for the filled glyph, which an icon subset without it drew as an empty tinted square.
entries.summary: View site round 2 (round/view-r8, DEV return R8-3): js/head.js _renderZone sets pressed and label-pressed only when the pair has the toggle look (frameworkToggle); otherwise it removes them and toggles .sf-view-head-zone-toggle--open; js/head.css draws --own.--open with the pressed tokens (--sf-icon-button-pressed-background-color or --sf-primary-container, on-primary-container, the 1 px primary ring, container hover and active); the toggle markup no longer writes pressed="false".

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. With head="list": a board and cards chosen in the view zone show their count line in the footer («1–16 из 60»); the head's words follow view-config/1 («Сохранить представление», «Сохранить как моё» for a view the person cannot write, «Сбросить»); on a phone the search field no longer widens the head past its box. A layout switched to while its code is on the way holds only the list's place with its skeleton (host attribute data-sf-layout-loading meanwhile); the head, the marks and the footer stay.
entries.summary: Round 8 (round/view-r8, R67-1, R67-2, VSA-1, VSA-5): js/head.css hides the footer start under a display kind other than the table only while the view has no count (:not([data-sf-view-footer-count])), and the phone search field takes contain: inline-size; index.js _drawCountFooter drops data-sf-view-footer-count for other kinds, _holdLayoutLoad after a layout change puts a skeleton of the layout (slot content, data-sf-layout-hold) until the element is defined and has drawn (8 s at most); js/head.js state panel offers headViewSaveMine «Сохранить как моё» for a system, unshareable or locked view; lang head-view-new and head-view-save-new «Сохранить представление», new head-view-save-mine.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. With simai.dataview-port 1.16.0 and personal-preferences, the view the person opened last (data.preferences.view, a saved view's key the host lists) opens by itself on load, with the layer's page size; opening another view saves it to the layer (preferences.save {view}).
entries.summary: View site round (round/view-site, dispatcher order 2026-11-20, view round 7 open item O5): _acceptPersonal opens the layer's view on its first answer through _openKeptView (the head's _openSavedView, else openView) after the answer's echo is read, unless the list already shows it; the page size rides with that query instead of a second ask; openView raises preferences.save {view} when the layer names another view. The kept view waits for the head's describe() answer (head.described) so it opens in its own layout.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. With head="list" a view's filter fields (settings.filter_fields) are put on the head row when it opens, and the default view's from the first answer, whether or not the host echoes filters_chosen; a view that keeps none no longer inherits the fields of the view left. Adding or removing a field of a shared or system view that keeps its fields marks it changed. A board and cards say their count in the footer («1–80 из 120», sf-pagination's range words); host attribute data-sf-view-footer-count while they do. Port: simai.dataview-port 1.16.0 is accepted (1.0.0..1.16.0): saved views of level package read as system (until 2027-01-01); with personal-preferences the page size and the view zone's open state are the person's layer on the host (data.preferences, preferences.save), else the browser as before. Default page size: a page that sets none now asks 20, not 25, and its menu is exactly 10/20/50/100 -- a host that assumed 25 sees per_page 20 in the first query (owner decision 2026-11-20). The «Показать ещё» look's range counts every row on screen («1–12 из 12»). Closing a record the host opened in its own panel gives the focus back to the record's row.
entries.summary: Round 7 (round/view-r7, VS-8, board and cards count; views study e072e2ab): js/head.js chosen falls back to the open view's settings.filter_fields (with the fields of its conditions) when the query has no filters_chosen; _openSavedView writes the view's fields as filters_chosen (or drops the previous ones); viewChanged compares the view's fields with the chosen ones. index.js _drawCountFooter: for layout board and cards the footer start shows the range of the records on screen of view.total in sf-pagination's words (range, range-many, read under sf-pagination; the page size and count offer hidden), the host attribute data-sf-view-footer-count keeps the footer part drawn without a page row; nothing before the first answer, for an empty, failed or refused list or with chrome without pagination. Port 1.16.0 (simai/ui-source feat/view-port-levels 264f42539, dispatcher order 2026-11-20): SUPPORTED_PORT_VERSIONS, x-port.supports and host_port.supported_versions + 1.16.0 (host_port.version stays 1.15.0 until the pinned pair carries the 1.16.0 contract); head.js viewLevel reads package as system; index.js _personalOffered (port >= 1.16.0 and personal-preferences), _acceptPersonal (data.preferences of an answer: zone via ListHead.keptChanged unless the person toggled, a page size other than the first query's asked once more), _savePersonal (preferences.save of the changed fields against the layer revision, one retry on a conflict's current_revision, quiet), keptPreferences prefers the layer, the browser copy kept for the first paint. Round 7 returns of DEV's round-5 acceptance (R5-1, R5-3, R5-4): VIEW_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE 20 replaces the literal 25 of the initial query, the echo fallback and the revalidation key; _drawFooter takes the range of a page row in appearance more from _shownRangeText (1–N of total, the board/cards count line's text); _watchHostRecordClose hears sf-view-properties-close on the document after a record.open without record-card and, when the focus was lost (body), focuses the record through _focusRecord (shared with the record card's close). The view-config/1 contract is in contracts/view-config/ of the repository.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. With head="list" the title row holds the list name only (the number of records is the footer's); the head row starts with a quiet view toggle (view_quilt) that opens the view zone below it: the open view's name and menu by level, the display kind, Настроить вид and, when the view is changed, Изменено with save as new, save for everyone (where allowed) and reset. The zone's open state is kept per person under preferences-key. The list menu moved to the end of the head row. Widths follow the text measure (C396): the notice is at most 44 steps (352 px at normal density, was 320) and the places window 52 (416, was 448); the skeleton's search field and toolbar end start from 44 (352, was 320), as the table's.
entries.summary: Round 6 (round/view-r6, VZ-1, owner C393, C394, views study option D): js/head.js draws the title row with the name only (data-count gone), the view toggle first in the head row (sf-button-icon, name and tooltip «Представление: <name>», badge-dot while the open view has unsaved changes, glyph tinted while a view other than the default is open, pressed and aria-expanded while the zone is open; appearance toggle where the page's sheets carry sf-icon-button--toggle, else the own look .sf-view-head-zone-toggle--own with the same tokens), the view zone (.sf-view-head-zone, --sf-outline-variant 1 px, --sf-radius--surface) with the views button (menu by level system / shared / personal with headings), sf-segmented of the kinds, Настроить вид and Изменено (state window: unsaved or mine note, save for everyone, save as new, reset); its open state in SF.Preferences (viewZone) read by keptPreferences, and the first-paint skeleton holds the zone row while it is kept open. «⋯» moved to the head row end. A page row without appearance takes --sf-pagination-divider-color: transparent (the footer draws the line). C396 (round 6): text-container widths moved from --sf-g* to the text measure var(--sf-measure-N, calc(N * var(--sf-text--size-1) / 2)): notice max g0 -> 44, places window g4 -> 52, skeleton search basis and toolbar end min g0 -> 44.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change. The calendar asks its range once: a query whose date field is not known yet leaves window.date_field out, and the answer is drawn as it comes. The footer's page size menu offers 10, 20, 50 and 100 (C388) when the page row has no page-sizes of its own; the page size in force is added when it is not one of them (25 by default). entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. New: the list head's display kind switches live between all four layouts of the set (table, board, cards, calendar; switchLayout keeps the marked records and the record card beside, the cards' page size of 24 gives the list's back on leaving them); cards and calendar are no longer shown disabled. Where the pair carries SF.fieldRenderers.filterWindow (C310, FO-5), a filter field of the list head opens the Framework's filter window and draws its summary (colour while active, the number only above 0, the words in the tooltip); without it the head's own window as before. The calendar's view-config/1 keys (span_days, rules) and the host's refusal codes storage_calendar_update_* are read (sf-view-calendar 1.1.0). DEV's round 3 returns: a display kind whose layout is not in the running set (its element neither defined nor a rule the Loader can fetch) is hidden in the head, not shown disabled (VR3-1); the head's menu separators draw as separators (VR3-2). A table or board after the cards or the calendar asks the list's own page size again (it was the page row's default, 25, after the calendar). The first range query no longer carries date_field null: the field comes from layouts.calendar, else the columns, else the host's description, and a range asked before any of them knows it is asked again once layouts.calendar names it (VCL-2).
entries.summary: View round 4 (round/view-r4, the dispatcher's merge of round/view-returns, round/view-cards and round/view-calendar): switchLayout(kind) works over every layout of the registry -- the content element is the layout's own (table, board, cards, calendar), a page's own element of another layout is parked with one console warning, the marked records go over to the new layout (sf-view-board, sf-view-cards and sf-view-calendar take selected) at once and again over the switch's own answer, the board's lanes become the list's records for the others, the calendar draws the known records on their days at once, the cards' per_page (24) gives the list's page size back when another layout is chosen and the window of the left layout is dropped from the query; selection reads the layout on screen. The list head therefore offers cards and calendar enabled when the host lists them. A filter field of the list head (C300, C310): with SF.fieldRenderers.filterWindow {open, summary} in the pair it opens filterWindow.open({anchor, field, value, size}) and applies {action: apply, value} or resets on {action: reset}; null changes nothing; the button reads filterWindow.summary(field, value) {active, count, words}; without it (the pair ui-1ed6b6c9a040) the head's own window as before; a head drawn before the field renderers loaded draws its fields again once they are in. entries.summary: C305 (1), RC-1: edit = group | group+quick | none (group+quick where the host allows editing). A short field (choice, date, time, yes/no, number) edits in a window at its value and saves one value through group.save. «Изменить всё» in the menu; a press on a long field's value opens its group with the focus on it (VP-19, VP-21); edited fields take the group's width (VP-27). New port intent record.history {record_id, collection, cursor, kinds, limit} for a host that announces record-history (pages of 20, 50 at most); a field the reader may not see comes as {field, label, sealed: true} and is said as «Значение скрыто», never drawn; SfPropertyView.historyFromRevisions builds the answer from stored revisions. C305 (4): a host that announces record-neighbours names the next and the previous record over its current view (record.neighbours, answered {listed, previous: {record_id}, next: {record_id}}); the step carries it as next_record_id and the card opens it. A save the host refuses with revision_moved (the revision moved, nothing written) is a conflict: the card says so, keeps what was typed and reads the record again. C305 (3), RC-4: the full screen keeps the section column (sf-menu until sf-tabs vertical places its box, VP-26), fields in two columns, the history as a 24rem column from 80rem (VP-22). C305 (4), RC-5: from 64rem the panel docks beside a list marked data-sf-drawer-dock-host (no scrim, the list usable); modal="true" keeps the scrim (VP-23). Alt+Down / Alt+Up ask for the next or the previous record (sf-view-properties-step); the focus stays in the panel. C159 (6): closing, stepping or opening another record over unsaved entries asks in the card first (sf-confirm: «Закрыть без сохранения» / «Вернуться к правке»). RC-6: seven public variables --sf-view-properties-label-width, -row-gap, -group-gap, -sections-width, -side-width, -current-background-color, -saved-background-color; --sf-property-view--sections-width is a former name until 2027-01-01. entries.consumer: Nothing to change. New: layouts.calendar.span_days (31 by default, up to 366) and layouts.calendar.rules of view-config/1 (Larena backend msg-75b451e2): past, weekdays {days: the ISO days 1..7 a start may fall on}, locked {field, in}, ability {ability} (answered per record in can {update, code, reason}); a rule without a reason and a host refusal coded storage_calendar_update_* are said in the language pack's words. weekdays {days} now names the days allowed (ISO 1..7), as the Larena host checks it, not days refused (0..6). DEV's acceptance (VCL-1, VCL-3, VCL-4): layouts.calendar mode opens the calendar when no mode attribute is written (it opened in month); «+N» is a text row at the event line height, so a month row is the number row and per_day lines (112 at per_day 3, the month 672 instead of 750); on a phone the chosen day's rows are two lines, the second «Кратко» field at the end of the title line, long values ending with «…». Phone month (C307 (3), (4), DEV msg-92a6590e9e1c4483bd21): the chosen day's heading under the month carries + (always shown there), creating on that day; «Без даты N» under the month swaps the chosen day's list for the records without a date (choosing a day swaps back); on a list row a held touch, Shift+F10 or the context menu opens the event menu, where «Перенести на…» sets the date. Words: undated-hint-phone, undated-list-opened-text, undated-list-closed-text (en, ru).
entries.summary: view-config/1 keys from the Larena backend (msg-75b451e2): calendarOptions reads span_days (31, clamped to 366; how far back the host looks for an event that started before the days on screen) and rules from layouts.calendar; the move rules in force are the rules setting and layouts.calendar.rules. moveCheck: weekdays {days} are the ISO days 1..7 a start may fall on (the host's reading; the round's own 0..6 refused days are gone), locked {field, in} holds a record whose field has one of the values (also with no day), ability is the host's and comes per record in can {update: false, code, reason}; sunday..saturday, min, max and dates are still read. A refusal carries its code; with no reason of its own a rule or a host refusal (storage_calendar_update_past, _weekday, _locked, _denied, _end_before_start, _too_long, _patch_invalid) is said in the pack's words (refuse-past, refuse-weekday, refuse-locked, refuse-denied, refuse-end-before-start, refuse-too-long, refuse-patch-invalid; en and ru); a machine code is never shown to a person. VCL-1: mode resolves the mode attribute only when written, then layouts.calendar mode, then month (getProp answered the property default, month, and hid the setting). VCL-3: «+N» is a plain button (sf-view-calendar__more) at --sf-text-height-1/2 instead of an sf-button of the control height; the day's block-size is padding + one control row + per_day text lines and gaps. VCL-4: the phone row's grid is time | title | auto, the second field on the title line (end), the first under the title, ellipsis on long values. Phone month: renderPhoneList draws «Без даты N» (data-undtoggle, aria-pressed) under the month and the chosen day's list (renderDayList with + in its heading, lday-h[data-picked]) or renderUndatedList (rows with data-ev, the close button data-undclose); phoneUndated is the phone's own state, apart from the saved undated_open, cleared by pickDay; toggleUndated on the phone's month toggles it. A touch held 700 ms on a list row opens openEventMenu (rows do not drag; the click after it is swallowed; a native contextmenu cancels the hold). The pick window (and the phone month panel) also hears sf-change, the name under which the pair's sf-input-date says a chosen day; with sf-input-date-change alone «Перенести на…» moved nothing. Undated phone rows have no time column.

entries.summary: New: the calendar layout (owner decision C307): month, week, day and list modes over the host's date window in the request's time zone and week start; all-day and multi-day bars and timed events in their option's colour; «+N» opens the day list; moves and stretches by mouse, touch and keys as a change of the date fields the host settles (settleMove), refused days dim with the reason; «Без даты N» column; «+» on a day; the phone month with dots; selection in the list mode; one Tab stop with the W3C date grid keys.
